subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

That which cannot be conquered
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 4'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**Invincible**" refers to something that cannot be conquered, defeated, or overcome. (अजेय)
 
• **Example:** The champion's winning streak made him seem invincible in the eyes of his opponents.

Hence, the correct answer is '**Invincible**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: Invisible** (अदृश्य) – Refers to something that cannot be seen.

 
 
• **Example:** The invisible ink revealed the secret message under UV light.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Indelible** (अमिट) – Refers to something that cannot be erased or removed.
 
 
• **Example:** The experience left an indelible mark on her memory.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Ineffable** (अवर्णनीय) – Refers to something too great or extreme to be expressed in words.
 
 
• **Example:** The beauty of the sunset over the mountains was ineffable.
